groups.defect: The removal-event listener can invoke unsupported setPermissionsEnabled cleanup on the V2 evaluator, causing deletion to throw.
groups.rationale: All three report the same listener-to-V2 dispatch failure, pointing either at the listener or the newly overridden clients() factory. Guarding that cleanup path resolves the shared defect.

groups.defect: Client-resource enumeration and lookup allegedly use inconsistent resource types, and enumeration can also include the all-clients resource name as a client ID.
groups.rationale: Both explicitly report that enumeration may miss per-client resources because of a resource-type mismatch. The first additionally reports the bogus all-clients entry, while the second identifies inconsistent lookup sites; these details must survive consolidation.

groups.defect: The Javadocs for void requireView() and requireViewClientScopes() incorrectly promise boolean return values instead of documenting exception behavior.
groups.rationale: These are repeated instances of the same documentation mistake in two methods. Each requires its own equivalent correction.
